summary: This Form 6-K (equivalent to a US quarterly report) filed by The Metals Royalty Company Inc. contains only unaudited interim financial statements and MD&A for the three months ended March 31, 2026. There is no mention of any corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. The filing shows a net loss from continuing operations and a small net income from discontinued operations, but no details of a special situation. As a routine periodic financial report with no transaction or event, this filing is not a special situation. No deal terms or advisor names are provided.
